name: Epigral Ltd
title: Epigral Ltd - 543332 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue record INR736 cr with utilisation above 80% and EBITDA margin 23%, but management gave no FY27 value or margin guidance and war-driven price gains are expected only in Q1.

utilisation.quote: resulting in overall plant utilization above 80 %

capex.quote: our capacity expansion projects of Epichlorohydrin and CPVC are progressing on track and within budget

triggers.label: Caustic utilisation 67-70% → 78-85%
triggers.quote: the plant that we were running at 67%, 70% utilization levels, after the November has been running in the range of 78% to 80%, 83%, 85% utilization levels

triggers.label: Caustic ECU ~INR37,000 vs ~INR30,000 in Q4
triggers.quote: current ECU would be ranging somewhere around INR37,000 kind of thing

triggers.label: FY27 volume growth 10-12%
triggers.quote: we are targeting around 10% to 12% of volume growth from here on

triggers.label: April volumes soft; growth from May
triggers.quote: April was bit of a quarter where there was a volume bit low compared to what it was in a normal case

triggers.label: Interest cost driven by FX mark-to-market
triggers.quote: it's just a mark-to-market impact which has been there in the interest cost put together

guidance.quote: we are targeting around 10% to 12% of volume growth from here on
we expect this 75% chlorine captive consumption to reach around 90% to 95% captive consumption
I would defer giving any guidance on the EBITDA margins. But what we have achieved so far, we would be maintaining in that range.

red_flags.label: Finance cost up ~35% from FX mark-to-market on swap
red_flags.quote: it's just a mark-to-market impact which has been there in the interest cost put together

red_flags.label: Chlorotoluene ramp slow, utilisation undisclosed
red_flags.quote: it will be difficult to give an absolute utilization level as of now

evasions.quote: It's difficult to give all the numbers together, maybe we can take this offline.
in terms of value growth, it will be difficult to give you any kind of specific guidance. We would avoid that.
I would avoid giving any number
